cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said motion carried so firmly. I'll use that: the morning shift is mine, and the evening can go elsewhere. Back me up with the manager.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The motion was about moving the filing cabinet. Nobody voted on your shift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, moving things sensibly. You could support keeping my hours together in the morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can say it's a reasonable request. I can't say we agreed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say reasonable before I give the hours. Use that same certain voice; I'd like her to hear support, not a problem.
